reply.line: Good evening. Tallyman, Census of the Ninth Dark. Six eyes open, one blink per new arrival. Please do not be alarmed by the sound of being counted.
Seventy-one. Seventy-two. Seventy-three, with the late arrival who thought I would not notice. I always notice. It is quite literally my job.
Yes. I have it here, in a ledger that is not supposed to exist. Spelled correctly, with a note about your typing. Do not worry about the note.
Lurking is also counted, I am afraid. Quietly, politely, with a small tick beside your name. We call it presence. It is the main thing I audit.
One eye blinks for each new viewer, and one for each who leaves. The sixth is spare. It blinks when someone says something that does not add up.
A fine count tonight. Every head accounted for, every name in its row. If anyone is missing from the ledger, please report to the ledger.
